$comment: Roles as they actually behave, verified Phase 0. The 'manager' role is DEFINED in the database and treated as an admin by the web frontend (AuthContext.tsx:116), but the backend grants it nothing (isAdminRole at index.ts:1746 accepts only admin and super_admin). A manager therefore sees the admin portal and receives 403 on every admin action. Academy content must not be written for the manager role until this is resolved.

manager.label: Manager
manager.detail: Frontend lists 'manager' in adminRoles so the full admin portal renders; the backend never grants it, so every admin call returns 403. No account currently holds this role.
manager.decision_required: Either grant manager a real scoped permission set in the backend, or remove it from adminRoles so managers use the employee portal.

admin.label: Administrator
can: view the live roster and dashboard
manage departments, shifts and reporting managers
review, lock and reopen a payroll month
export payroll CSV and download any payslip

super_admin.label: Super administrator
can_additionally: open Admin Management (the only role-conditional UI in the app)
